canonical_source.checkpoint_policy: This file follows the implementation and guard; read its own commit from Git history, not a circular self-reference.

implemented: Bounded JSON reads with campaign/revision and display-record validation.
Synchronous duplicate-submission lock and session-local uncertain receipt recovery; no automatic resend.
Campaign/scene-scoped draft preservation and pending-action recovery controls.
Native integration adapter for authorization, idempotent receipts, revision checks, history preservation and atomic state/receipt storage through required host callbacks.
Discovery-, visibility-, entity- and time-aware scene selection with failed-image fallback.
Bounded allowlisted checkpoint copying and isolated synthetic action-save-projection-reload test.
Complete runtime/shared-source checksum coverage with negative drift tests and release pin validation.
remaining: Obtain the existing native Site source and reconcile the bundled source; perform full typecheck/build and native publication.
Connect and test the actual native authentication, durable transaction, safe projection and existing source-backed resolver adapters. Synthetic in-memory tests do not establish production guarantees.
Verify deployed desktop/390px and physical iPhone journeys, microphone permissions and actual speaker/headphone listening.
Complete exact plugin binary/media export and GitHub parity verification.
synchronization: Inspect actual main ref and current plugin release before editing; use tested coherent commits, not per-file pushes. Validate source checksums, tests and exact Git tree; publish a guarded text overlay preserving omitted media; inspect published readback; merge only the expected tested head; then record external release guard and checkpoint. No continuous auto-sync is claimed.

rollback.procedure: Review current heads and restore only intended source through a new commit and guarded plugin update. Never reset the real campaign. No production database migration or native Site publication occurred.
